{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

Now, design the fix for gh-846:

**Root cause:** The `update_branch` localAction (the silent-update/refresh path in the SM tick) refreshes the branch to the new head but never cancels CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded old head. Cancellation of stale-head runs only happens in the `validate_pr` arm path — so when a tick refreshes a branch without dispatching fresh CI (e.g. PR not in the validate queue that tick), the stale run stays queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457, run queued 50+ min on dead head 1ed928).

Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` only queries `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR head are never cancelled.

**Fix plan:**

1. In the `update_branch` path, after `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` succeeds, cancel stale dispatched runs whose head_sha != the new head. Need to know the new head: re-resolve the head sha after the refresh (the refresh was a git merge push; resolve via `resolveHeadSha`). Cancel BEFORE... well in update_branch there is no dispatch in the same action. But the ordering AC says cancel before dispatching fresh validation — in update_branch, the dispatch happens on a later tick via validate-armed; that's fine. But actually the ticket says "Ordering: cancel BEFORE dispatching the fresh validation on the new head" — in the validate_pr path cancelStaleDispatchedRuns is already called before dispatchCiWorkflow. For update_branch, we cancel after refresh.

   Hmm, wait — but there's a subtlety: gh-798 leg exclusion. The refresh is deferred when a leg is in flight. If refresh deferred, head unchanged → no cancel needed. Good: only cancel when the refresh actually happened.

2. Extend the cancel to cover push-event validation runs too. The query `runs?event=workflow_dispatch` only covers dispatched runs. The ticket: "cancel ALL dispatched CI runs (workflow_dispatch AND push-triggered validation runs) whose head_sha != the new head". So we should also query push-event runs of the CI workflow with head_branch === branch. But the guard: "never cancel the merge winner's own post-merge main CI (main-branch push runs are out of scope — this rule targets PR-head dispatches only)". Filtering by `head_branch === branch` handles this: main push runs have head_branch === 'main' ≠ PR branch.

   However — careful with push-event runs on the PR branch: a push-triggered CI on the PR branch could be from an agent leg push or the kicker? The kicker has its own workflow. The CI workflow (quality.yml) triggered by push to the PR branch — e.g., when the agent pushes commits, the CI runs on push. If the branch just got refreshed, runs on the old head are stale. But what if the old-head push CI run is still meaningful... no — the head moved; the old run's result would be discarded. Cancel.

   Hmm, but wait: should we be careful about cancelling push-triggered runs that were triggered by something other than validation? The ticket says "push-triggered validation runs". The workflow filter (ciWorkflow) scopes to the validation workflow only. Good.

3. Marker: "post/refresh the once-per-head bookkeeping so the cancelled-as-stale reason is recorded (gh-755 parity: CANCELLED is never a verdict — the zombie re-dispatch and red-head machinery must treat 'cancelled: stale base' as no-verdict)". Since CANCELLED is already never a verdict (latestDispatchedVerdict skips cancelled, hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun ignores cancelled), the main machinery already handles it. But the twin guard "cancel only once, log the reason" (gh-748): the cancel API on an already-cancelled run is idempotent-ish, but we should avoid cancelling runs that are already completed-cancelled — the filter only cancels queued/in_progress/waiting/pending runs, so a run already cancelled (completed+cancelled) won't be re-cancelled. "Cancel only once" is naturally satisfied since after cancel the run becomes completed/cancelled and leaves the active filter. Log the reason — we log with console.log including head sha. {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

**Root cause:** The `update_branch` localAction (the silent-update/refresh path in the SM tick) refreshes the branch to the new head but never cancels CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded old head. Cancellation of stale-head runs only happens in the `validate_pr` arm path — so when a tick refreshes a branch without dispatching fresh CI (e.g. PR not in the validate queue that tick), the stale run stays queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457, run queued 50+ min on dead head 1ed928).

Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` only queries `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR head are never cancelled.

**Fix plan:**

1. In the `update_branch` path, after `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` succeeds, cancel stale dispatched runs whose head_sha != the new head. Need to know the new head: re-resolve the head sha after the refresh (the refresh was a git merge push; resolve via `resolveHeadSha`). Cancel BEFORE... well in update_branch there is no dispatch in the same action. But the ordering AC says cancel before dispatching fresh validation — in update_branch, the dispatch happens on a later tick via validate-armed; that's fine. For update_branch, we cancel after refresh.

Actually no: if we resolve to the OLD head (pre-refresh), then runs with head_sha !== oldSha include runs on the NEW head — that would cancel the fresh run! Dangerous. {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

Now I have a good understanding. Design decision time.

The scope of the fix (minimal, targeted):

1. **Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`** to also cover push-event runs of the CI workflow on the PR branch (head_branch === branch, head_sha !== currentSha, active states). Keep the workflow_dispatch query and add a push query. Guard: main-branch push runs are excluded by head_branch === branch filter.

2. **Call it from the `update_branch` path** after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`: cancel stale runs whose head_sha != the (new) head. The new head needs to be resolved after refresh — `resolveHeadSha` re-reads the PR head. Note: the update path already has `uHead` (pre-refresh head). After the refresh the head moves; re-resolve. But there's a subtlety: resolving the head again costs an API call per PR refreshed. Acceptable.

   Ordering per the ticket: "cancel BEFORE dispatching the fresh validation on the new head" — in update_branch there is no dispatch. But wait: there's also the AC1 "replay the #1457 18:07 timeline — the stale run is cancelled within the same tick that refreshes the head (≤1 tick)". So update_branch is exactly the right place.

   Also, should the cancel happen before the refresh? No — before refresh, the "current head" is the old head; cancelling relative to the old head would cancel nothing (runs match the old head). Must cancel relative to the NEW head, after the refresh.

3. **Marker**: post a stale-cancel bookkeeping record. Per the ticket: "Marker: post/refresh the once-per-head bookkeeping so the cancelled-as-stale reason is recorded (gh-755 parity: CANCELLED is never a verdict...)". 

   Where does bookkeeping matter? The concern: after we cancel a stale run on the old head, some other machinery reading the PR might see the CANCELLED run and misinterpret. Machinery reading dispatched runs on a head:
   - `latestDispatchedVerdict(head)` — skips cancelled. ✓ no verdict churn.
   - `hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun` — only success covers. ✓
   - zombie machinery — probes CURRENT head only. The old head isn't re-armed. ✓
   - red-head counters — keyed by sha in fail-report markers. The cancelled stale run never produces a fail report (fail_validation requires checks red on the PR; the PR head moved). ✓
   
   So the marker is mostly audit. Minimal approach: extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to return the list of cancelled runs (count + heads), and in the update_branch path post ONE marker comment per refresh when cancels happened, e.g.:

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

Now let me write the RCA and plan the implementation concretely.

**RCA:**
- Bug: Stale-head CI runs are only cancelled on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at line 2162). The silent-update/refresh path (`update_branch` localAction, `silentUpdateBranch`) moves the head without cancelling runs dispatched on the now-superseded head. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to cover both `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch (head_branch === branch filter keeps main-branch push runs out of scope — the merge winner's post-merge main CI is untouchable). Return the cancelled run list for marker bookkeeping. Add DRY guard.
2. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-resolve the head sha (the refresh moved it) and cancel stale dispatched runs relative to the NEW head, posting a once-per-head stale-cancel marker comment when anything was cancelled.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

The scope of the fix (minimal, targeted):

1. **Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`** to also cover push-event runs of the CI workflow on the PR branch (head_branch === branch, head_sha !== currentSha, active states). Keep the workflow_dispatch query and add a push query. Guard: main-branch push runs are excluded by head_branch === branch filter.

2. **Call it from the `update_branch` path** after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`: cancel stale runs whose head_sha != the (new) head. The new head needs to be resolved after refresh — `resolveHeadSha` re-reads the PR head. Note: the update path already has `uHead` (pre-refresh head). After the refresh the head moves; re-resolve. But there's a subtlety: resolving the head again costs an API call per PR refreshed. Acceptable.

   Ordering per the ticket: "cancel BEFORE dispatching the fresh validation on the new head" — in update_branch there is no dispatch. But wait: there's also the AC1 "replay the #1457 18:07 timeline — the stale run is cancelled within the same tick that refreshes the head (≤1 tick)". So update_branch is exactly the right place.

   Also, should the cancel happen before the refresh? No — before refresh, the "current head" is the old head; cancelling relative to the old head would cancel nothing (runs match the old head). Must cancel relative to the NEW head, after the refresh.

3. **Marker**: post a stale-cancel bookkeeping record. Per the ticket: "Marker: post/refresh the once-per-head bookkeeping so the cancelled-as-stale reason is recorded (gh-755 parity: CANCELLED is never a verdict...)". 

   Where does bookkeeping matter? The concern: after we cancel a stale run on the old head, some other machinery reading the PR might see the CANCELLED run and misinterpret. Machinery reading dispatched runs on a head:
   - `latestDispatchedVerdict(head)` — skips cancelled. ✓ no verdict churn.
   - `hasSuccessfulDispatchedRun` — only success covers. ✓
   - zombie machinery — probes CURRENT head only. The old head isn't re-armed. ✓
   - red-head counters — keyed by sha in fail-report markers. The cancelled stale run never produces a fail report (fail_validation requires checks red on the PR; the PR head moved). ✓
   
   So the marker is mostly audit. Minimal approach: extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to return the list of cancelled runs (count + heads), and in the update_branch path post ONE marker comment per refresh when cancels happened, e.g.:

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

OK, the mock for `github_get_pr` returns `opts.github.pr` — I can use that to simulate the head moving after refresh (return different sha per call count).

Now let me write the RCA and plan the implementation concretely.

**RCA:**
- Bug: Stale-head CI runs are only cancelled on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at line 2162). The silent-update/refresh path (`update_branch` localAction, `silentUpdateBranch`) moves the head without cancelling runs dispatched on the now-superseded head. Live fa #1457: CI dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928; the tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608; the 18:07 run stayed QUED 50+ min on the dead head, blocking the mac runner queue. Also, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` only queries `event=workflow_dispatch` — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never cancelled.

**Fix:**
1. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to cover both `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch (head_branch === branch filter keeps main-branch push runs out of scope — the merge winner's post-merge main CI is untouchable). Return the cancelled run list for marker bookkeeping. Add DRY guard.
2. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-resolve the head sha (the refresh moved it) and cancel stale dispatched runs relative to the NEW head, posting a once-per-head stale-cancel marker comment when anything was cancelled.

Wait — one ordering consideration in update_branch: the head after refresh must be resolved. `resolveHeadSha` prefers `ticket.pr.headSha || ticket.headSha` — which is the STALE pre-refresh sha cached on the ticket. So I must bypass the ticket cache. Options: call `github_get_pr` directly, or resolve before refresh and... no. Actually, before the refresh, uHead is the OLD head. After refresh, need new head. `resolveHeadSha` will return the ticket's cached headSha if present — wrong. I need a fresh read. I'll add a small inline probe: call github_get_pr fresh and read pr.head.sha; on failure fall back to... hmm, if the fresh read fails, we can't know the new head — skip cancel that tick (fail closed: stale runs survive one more tick, never canceling the wrong runs). That's the safe behavior.

Wait, but there's a subtlety: the marker/AC4 "the current head's runs are never touched" — cancelling relative to a wrong (old) sha would cancel runs on the current head! Actually no: if we resolve to the OLD head (pre-refresh), then runs with head_sha !== oldSha include runs on the NEW head — that would cancel the fresh run! Dangerous. So the fresh read is essential, and on failure we must skip.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}
