OK, the mock for `github_get_pr` returns `opts.github.pr` — I can use that to simulate the head moving after refresh (return different sha per call count).

Now let me write the RCA and plan the implementation concretely.

**RCA:**
- Bug: Stale-head CI runs are only cancelled on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at line 2162). The silent-update/refresh path (`update_branch` localAction, `silentUpdateBranch`) moves the head without cancelling runs dispatched on the now-superseded head. Live fa #1457: CI dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928; the tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608; the 18:07 run stayed QUED 50+ min on the dead head, blocking the mac runner queue. Also, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` only queries `event=workflow_dispatch` — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never cancelled.

**Fix:**
1. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to cover both `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch (head_branch === branch filter keeps main-branch push runs out of scope — the merge winner's post-merge main CI is untouchable). {"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).

## gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

### Root Cause
The silent-update/refresh path (`update_branch` localAction) moved the PR head via `silentUpdateBranch` but never cancelled CI runs dispatched on the superseded head — stale cancels only happened on the `validate_pr` arm path (live: fa #1457, run queued 50+ min on dead head `1ed928` after the tick refreshed to `0d65608`). Also, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` only swept `workflow_dispatch` runs, never push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` — `update_branch`: after a successful refresh, re-read the PR head fresh (`freshHeadSha` — the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one; a stale-sha selection could hit current-head runs, AC4) and cancel stale dispatched runs against the NEW head in the same tick (AC1); one bookkeeping comment records `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict, no fail-validation/zombie/red-head churn, AC3).
- `js/smAgent.js` — `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`: sweeps both `workflow_dispatch` AND `push` events of the CI workflow; `head_branch === branch` filter keeps the merge winner's post-merge main CI out of scope; only ACTIVE runs are selected so cancel-only-once (gh-748) is structural; DRY ticks cancel nothing; returns the cancelled runs for the marker.
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — `staleCancelMarkerLine` + `STALE_CANCEL_MARKER_RE` (marker format next to the zombie markers).

### Test Coverage
- TDD RED→GREEN: 2 new reproduction tests failed first, then passed.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` — 6 gh-846 tests: same-tick cancel of a QUEUED run on the superseded head (#1457 timeline replay, AC1); push-triggered runs cancelled while main-branch and current-head runs stay untouched; leg-in-flight deferral ⇒ no refresh/no cancel; unreadable post-refresh head ⇒ cancel skipped (fail closed, AC4); DRY ⇒ no side effects.
- `js/unit-tests/test_validationLiveness.js` — stale-cancel marker round-trip + no interference with zombie counting.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2496 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (fa-state snapshot replay) and L3 (live mac-queue soak) remain post-merge verification; unit level covers the selection logic and guards.
- Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel for one tick (fail closed) — stale runs self-heal on the next refresh; a wrongful cancel of a current-head run is the worse failure.

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).

{"content":"## gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

### Root Cause
The silent-update/refresh path (`update_branch` localAction) moved the PR head via `silentUpdateBranch` but never cancelled CI runs dispatched on the superseded head — stale cancels only happened on the `validate_pr` arm path (live: fa #1457, run queued 50+ min on dead head `1ed928` after the tick refreshed to `0d65608`). Also, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` only swept `workflow_dispatch` runs, never push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch.

### Fix
- `js/smAgent.js` — `update_branch`: after a successful refresh, re-read the PR head fresh (`freshHeadSha` — the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one; a stale-sha selection could hit current-head runs, AC4) and cancel stale dispatched runs against the NEW head in the same tick (AC1); one bookkeeping comment records `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict, no fail-validation/zombie/red-head churn, AC3).
- `js/smAgent.js` — `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns`: sweeps both `workflow_dispatch` AND `push` events of the CI workflow; `head_branch === branch` filter keeps the merge winner's post-merge main CI out of scope; only ACTIVE runs are selected so cancel-only-once (gh-748) is structural; DRY ticks cancel nothing; returns the cancelled runs for the marker.
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — `staleCancelMarkerLine` + `STALE_CANCEL_MARKER_RE` (marker format next to the zombie markers).

### Test Coverage
- TDD RED→GREEN: 2 new reproduction tests failed first, then passed.
- `js/unit-tests/test_smAgent.js` — 6 gh-846 tests: same-tick cancel of a QUEUED run on the superseded head (#1457 timeline replay, AC1); push-triggered runs cancelled while main-branch and current-head runs stay untouched; leg-in-flight deferral ⇒ no refresh/no cancel; unreadable post-refresh head ⇒ cancel skipped (fail closed, AC4); DRY ⇒ no side effects.
- `js/unit-tests/test_validationLiveness.js` — stale-cancel marker round-trip + no interference with zombie counting.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` — 2496 passed, 0 failed.

### Notes
- L2 (fa-state snapshot replay) and L3 (live mac-queue soak) remain post-merge verification; unit level covers the selection logic and guards.
- Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel for one tick (fail closed) — stale runs self-heal on the next refresh; a wrongful cancel of a current-head run is the worse failure.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# gh-846 — Cancel stale-head CI runs on base move

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: When a merge lands on main and the SM tick silently refreshes a PR branch (the `update_branch` localAction / silent-update-behind rule), CI runs dispatched on the now-superseded head are NOT cancelled. Cancellation of stale-head runs happens only on the `validate_pr` arm path (`cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` at `js/smAgent.js` ~line 2162), so a refresh tick that does not also arm validation leaves the dead-head run queued indefinitely (live: fa #1457 — run dispatched 18:07 on head 1ed928, tick refreshed the branch to 0d65608, the 18:07 run stayed QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction (~lines 1798–1829): both refresh branches call `silentUpdateBranch(ticket.branch)` and stop. Nothing cancels dispatched validation runs whose `head_sha` differs from the new head. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` (~line 3755) queries only `event=workflow_dispatch` runs — push-triggered validation runs on the PR branch are never selected.

**Impact**: Any PR whose head goes behind main while a validation run is queued/in-progress keeps burning scarce self-hosted (macOS) runner time on a head whose result would be discarded. The cancel happens only if/when the PR later re-enters the validate-pr arm — which can be never within the stall window.

**Fix approach**:
1. In the `update_branch` path, after a successful `silentUpdateBranch`, re-read the PR head fresh (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one) and call `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` against the NEW head — cancel happens in the SAME tick that refreshes the head (AC1). Post-refresh head read failure skips the cancel (fail closed — never cancel against a stale sha, which could hit current-head runs, AC4).
2. Extend `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` to select BOTH `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events of the CI workflow on the PR branch. The `head_branch === branch` filter keeps main-branch push runs (the merge winner's post-merge CI) out of scope.
3. Marker: post one bookkeeping comment per refresh carrying a machine-parseable `🛑 stale-cancel <sha> — stale base at <iso>` line per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — CANCELLED is never a verdict; the existing verdict/zombie/red-head machinery already skips cancelled conclusions and keys per head sha, so no verdict churn, AC3).
4. Guards: only ACTIVE runs (queued/in_progress/waiting/pending) are selected — a run already cancelled is `completed/cancelled` and can never be re-selected (gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural); runs on the current head are never selected; DRY ticks cancel nothing.

**Previous attempt**: None — fresh bug (family: gh-748 dispatch-race guard, gh-755 cancelled-never-verdict, gh-821 zombie re-dispatch).
"}

### Root Cause
The silent-update/refresh path (`update_branch` localAction) moved the PR head via `silentUpdateBranch` but never cancelled CI runs dispatched on the superseded head — stale cancels only happened on the `validate_pr` arm path (live: fa #1457, run queued 50+ min on dead head `1ed928` after the tick refreshed to `0d65608`). Done. gh-846 is fixed with a full TDD cycle.

## Summary

**Root cause** (in `outputs/rca.md`): The SM tick's silent-update/refresh path (`update_branch` localAction in `js/smAgent.js`) moved the PR head via `silentUpdateBranch` but never cancelled CI runs dispatched on the superseded head — stale cancels only fired on the `validate_pr` arm path. That's exactly the fa #1457 timeline: CI dispatched 18:07 on head `1ed928`, the tick refreshed the branch to `0d65608`, and the dead-head run sat QUEUED 50+ min ahead of useful mac queue work. Additionally, `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` only swept `workflow_dispatch` events, never push-triggered validation runs.

**Fix**:
- `js/smAgent.js` — after a successful refresh, the update path re-reads the head **fresh** (the ticket-cached sha is the pre-refresh one — selecting against it could cancel current-head runs, AC4) and cancels stale runs in the **same tick** (AC1), posting one `🛑 stale-cancel <sha>` bookkeeping marker comment per cancelled head (gh-755 parity — no verdict churn, AC3).
- `cancelStaleDispatchedRuns` now sweeps **both** `workflow_dispatch` and `push` events; the `head_branch === branch` filter keeps the merge winner's post-merge main CI out of scope; only active runs are selected so gh-748 cancel-only-once is structural; DRY ticks cancel nothing.
- `js/common/validationLiveness.js` — new `staleCancelMarkerLine`/`STALE_CANCEL_MARKER_RE` next to the zombie markers.

**Verification**: 2 reproduction tests failed first (RED), then passed after the fix (GREEN); 6 new smAgent tests cover the #1457 replay, push-event + main-branch/current-head guards, leg-deferral, fail-closed head read, and DRY; 2 new validationLiveness tests cover the marker. Full suite: **2496 passed, 0 failed**.

**Note**: the repo's timer auto-save committed the first half of the change mid-session (`c09d71b`); the remaining working-tree diff (the `update_branch` wiring + marker tests) was verified by the final full-suite run and is left for post-processing to commit, per the pack's git handling.
